text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah... hah, hah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A while after the summer training camp 
began, 
Phalaenopsis was pushing her limits to 
keep up 
with the grueling regimen I had assigned.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... Trainer. 
That completes it, does it not?
choice_data_list: Yeah, great work! Let's cool down!
Yes, great work! Let's cool down!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Understood... Whew...
choice_data_list: Oh, by the way. Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hand her some homemade orange juice. 
Since she is a light eater, I chose a 
drink that 
would let her easily take in 
carbohydrates.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You have my thanks... *gulp*, *gulp*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After finishing the regimen, she looked 
thoroughly exhausted. Yet, she never once 
voiced a complaint or threw in the towel.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. 
I place tomorrow in your hands as well.
choice_data_list: Right...! Let's give it our all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll provide all the support I can, 
doing everything in my power to help her 
see it through. 
As her Trainer, I have to step up and push 
myself too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —However, the next morning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Something happened without my knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What is this...? 
The sun feels awfully hot today...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...? Phaleno-chan? 
Your face is red, you know? What's the 
matter?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Is it...? ...Hmm. 
I suppose I should check my temperature, 
just in case...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Where... is the thermometer? 
There's no time... Quickly...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I must... go—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Wait, Phaleno-chan!!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I waited on the beach for Phalaenopsis 
to arrive, 
just like any other day...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are!! 
Phaleno-chan's Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi. A classmate 
of Phalaenopsis 
with a frail constitution, she was an 
endlessly cheerful horsegirl 
expected to accomplish great things going 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I-I-It's an emergency! 
Ph-Phaleno-chan, she's...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rushing to the infirmary, I found 
Phalaenopsis 
lying down with her eyes closed...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
It seems she had temporary trouble 
regulating her body temperature, 
resulting in a state similar to 
heatstroke.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
However, after cooling her body down with 
ice packs and the like, 
she is stable now, so there's no need 
to worry excessively.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right! She even drank 
my Tsuyoshi-brand chilled health drink! 
That should've cooled her fever right down 
in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. 
Did you come all this way? My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I was mindful of the temperature, 
yet it seems my inverted body temperature 
flared up after so long.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Still, everyone administered the proper 
treatment. 
At this rate, I can resume training this 
afternoon—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Eep...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list:
Regardless, let's take today off to 
rest...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let us speak elsewhere 
later. 
—Tsuyoshi. Thank you for passing along the 
word.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We walked in silence to the shade near the 
training camp lodgings. 
...The moment we arrived, my emotions 
burst forth.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry. I... got ahead of myself.
I'm sorry. I... got ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her hard work had drawn more members to 
the club. 
Seeing those tangible results firsthand, 
I let my enthusiasm run away with me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought that seizing victory in the 
Shuka Sho 
would lead to even greater prosperity for 
the club.
choice_data_list:
My ego put way too heavy a burden on 
you...

My ego put way too heavy a burden on 
you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Assuming someone as resilient as her could 
manage it, 
I pushed a self-serving training regimen 
onto her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calling it "trust" might make it sound 
noble, 
but that wasn't what it was... It was 
nothing more than arrogant presumption.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: Even worse... I was being totally selfish.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And she did manage to complete it. But 
that regimen 
was designed by someone blinded by 
immediate victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she collapses now, it defeats the 
entire purpose. 
...I completely disregarded Phalaenopsis's 
future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was... as someone who supports an 
Umamusume by her side... 
...the very thing I should have avoided at 
all costs.
choice_data_list:
I'll rethink the training regimen. ...I'm 
sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I bowed my head. Not knowing how I could 
ever make up 
for the mistake I'd made, I could only 
apologize...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ......Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hear me. Hear me well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ――Lift your head.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You were not mistaken in the slightest!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You wish for me to claim the Shuka Sho, do 
you not? 
That is why you devised that regimen, is 
it not?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
What part of that could possibly be 
wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Self-serving? ――Splendid! 
Impose your self-righteousness upon me, 
then!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I shall bear it all. Every last bit.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Naturally, I too was at fault. I will 
concede as much. 
Allowing my body to falter was a grave 
misstep.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Because I was too eager to surge ahead, 
I placed this body in peril. 
I must take far greater care from now on.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even so. 
Do not stop expecting great things of me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...What you handed me 
was not some fatal misjudgment meant to 
break me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
――It was your expectations. 
A warm conviction that I was capable of 
bearing it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Then demand it of me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Demand as much as you will. Of your 
master. 
Of me, the one you expect so much of.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I shall rise to meet it, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
For Phalaenopsis is 
precisely that kind of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: And I shall prove it to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After resting thoroughly through the 
morning, 
we stood upon the beach to fulfill 
today's training quota.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that good rest, her body 
temperature had 
settled back down. Resuming training was 
technically possible now, and yet――

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...If you judge, even for a moment, that 
we 
must cease, call a halt to it that very 
instant.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
However, if that is not the case―― 
do not stand in my way.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To claim victory, I wish to see through 
the discipline 
laid before me by my trusted disciple.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hah――

text_block_list.name: Timer
text_block_list.text: (Beep, beep, beep, beep, BEEP!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah... hah, hah...―― 
Look, Trainer. Look at me. Believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ――I shall rise to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her, I was reminded once again 
of why so many people cheer for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis blooms all the more 
beautifully―― 
for every measure of expectation, every 
drop of water poured upon her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that... seeing her like this, 
as her Trainer, I couldn't help but――
choice_data_list: (Want to give her everything I have...!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
*Haaah*... Well? 
Did you feast your eyes, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even now, would you still underestimate 
me?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...What have you decided? 
Speak it aloud.
choice_data_list:
Even after seeing you collapse――I will 
still "demand it of you."

Even though you collapsed once――I will 
still "demand it of you."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, that is well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I intended nothing less from the start.
choice_data_list:
We'll see this through together, without 
fail.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Now that is the look I wished to 
see.
